before_conditions: Alice has TRUST locked throughout the entire epoch n.
The attacker does not have a TRUST lock that was active during epoch n.
The attacker has sufficient TRUST to create a large lock.
The attacker can submit a transaction at the exact timestamp epochTimestampEnd(n).
required_property: Reward snapshots for epoch n should only include veTRUST locks that were active during epoch n, so that only users who locked TRUST during epoch n can claim epoch n rewards.
bad_outcome: The attacker locks TRUST at the boundary timestamp epochTimestampEnd(n), which is included in epoch n's snapshot, and then calls claimRewards() to receive a pro-rata share of epoch n's emissions as real native tokens, diluting legitimate bonders' rewards.
